topic: Stages in the Life Cycle of Organisms
key_concepts: A life cycle is a series of changes an organism undergoes over one generation
Most plants begin their life cycle with seeds
A seed contains an embryo or baby plant and needs sun, air, temperature, and water to grow
Germination is the stage when a seed grows a little sprout
A seedling grows its leaves toward sunlight to help produce food
A mature plant produces flowers and seeds and has leaves, roots, stems, flowers, and fruit
Animals begin life either from an egg or as a baby born ready for life
Metamorphosis is the way insects develop, grow, and change, often with a change of habitat
Complete metamorphosis has four stages: egg, larva, pupa, and adult
Butterfly larvae are caterpillars that molt or shed their exoskeletons as they grow
In the pupa stage, larvae make a cocoon and change into their adult forms without eating
The human life cycle includes birth, infancy, childhood, adolescence, and adulthood
